# C2PA Technical Specification

> C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) defines an end-to-end, open technical standard for certifying the provenance and history of digital media content.

- [Soft Binding API](specifications/2.4/softbinding/Decoupled.html.md): This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.
